description: This Java source file defines the class RelatedEntitiesArgumentEntry, which manages a collection of entity argument entries for related entities, providing methods for updating, retrieving latest timestamps, and converting to specific argument representations within the context of aggregation state management.

classes.name: RelatedEntitiesArgumentEntry
classes.description: Represents an argument entry for related entities, holding a map of entity IDs to argument entries, with methods for updating entries, retrieving latest timestamps, and converting to argument representations.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of argument entry, specifically RELATED_ENTITIES.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the internal map of entity inputs.

methods.name: getLatestTs
methods.description: Calculates and returns the latest timestamp among contained argument entries.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates the current entry with another entry, handling different types and enforcing entity limits.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the entity inputs map is empty.

methods.name: toTbelCfArg
methods.description: Converts the entity inputs to a TbelCfRelatedEntitiesArgumentValue object.
